info.title: GainingSocial Unified Social API
info.description: Social execution infrastructure for software and AI agents. All timestamps are UTC ISO-8601. All resource ids are prefixed and opaque.

get.description: Returns 200 whenever the Worker can serve requests. Unauthenticated, and returns no tenant data. Does not check database connectivity — a database blip should not make the platform recycle a Worker that can still serve cached and queue-bound work.

get.description:
Returns the tenant and scopes the presented key resolves to. Requires a valid key but no particular scope — a key may always describe itself, and requiring a scope would stop a misconfigured key from discovering why it is misconfigured.

Requires scope: none beyond a valid key.

post.description:
A profile is the white-label tenant primitive — your customer, brand, location or creator identity. Everything publishable hangs off one. Supplying `external_id` is recommended: it makes creation naturally idempotent from your side, because a repeat conflicts rather than silently creating a duplicate customer.

Requires scope: `profiles:write`.

get.description:
Cursor-paginated, newest first. The cursor is the last id on the previous page, so a row inserted mid-pagination cannot shift a page boundary and make you skip or repeat an item — which offset pagination over an actively-written table does.

Requires scope: `profiles:read`.

get.description:
What THIS destination can actually do, narrowed by granted scopes, account type, subscription, platform approval and rollout. Every capability that is unavailable carries a `restrictions` entry explaining why and what would lift it — `video: false` alone cannot distinguish "unsupported" from "missing a scope", and the fix differs.

Requires scope: `capabilities:read`.
